title: Roles matrix and key rotation flow notes
content:
Goal
- Produce a compact Roles Matrix view + team-level key lifecycle UI that makes it quick to: (1) understand who has what access, (2) rotate/issue keys with a safe preview, and (3) correlate audit events to specific tokens/keys. Focus is console UX; infra implications noted but out of scope for this doc.

Context / constraints
- Customers want both org-wide RBAC and team-scoped templates. Current console exposes flat role lists which leaks noise for large orgs.
- Key rotation needs to be non-disruptive: allow overlap window, preview impacted routes, and automated rollout to dedicated pools.
- Audit log retention/filters are product-level (opt-in longer retention) but UX should make short-term triage fast (last 7/30 days).

High-level proposal
1) Roles Matrix page (tabbed):
   - Global roles grid (columns: Role, Description, Org-members, Teams, Assigned-by)
   - Team matrix (select team -> matrix rows = principals (users, service accounts, groups), columns = role primitives (read, write, deploy, billing))
   - Quick filters: show-only-teams-with-internal-access, highlight-privileged-roles, search-by-principal
   - Inline actions: edit assignment (pencil), view assignment history (clock icon), escalate (request access CTA)
   - Wireframe note: compact rows, color-coded role severity (gray/amber/red) with tooltip showing exact permissions.

2) Key lifecycle panel (sidecar or modal on Service Accounts page):
   - Modes: Create API key, Rotate key, Schedule rotation (cron-like cadence), Revoke key.
   - Rotation flow (sketch):
       a) Select service account or team key bucket
       b) Choose rotation type: instant / staged (recommended)
       c) Staged: set overlap window (default 24h) and preview which endpoints/routes and dedicated pools will read the new key during rollout
       d) Dry-run preview: list impacted routes, approximate % of traffic that will hit new key (estimated from routing rules), conflicts (e.g., third-party integrations with pinned key)
       e) Confirm -> create new key with URN, show copy-once secret + instructions for SDK and curl snippets
   - UX microcopy: emphasize copy-once behavior, provide explicit command to replace env var across popular orchestration (K8s secret example, Docker env, Terraform snippet).

3) Audit log correlation UI (integrated into key lifecycle and roles matrix):
   - Inline 'Show audit for this principal/key' that opens a filtered audit timeline pane (top filters: time-range, route, model, IP, status code)
   - Event grouping: bundle continuous token refresh events vs. first-use events; show 'first seen' and 'last seen' per key
   - Quick action from event: "Revoke key" or "Mute alerts for this key for X hours" (temporary suppression during rotation)

Wireframe alternatives considered
- Matrix + timeline combined (single pane) vs. separate matrix + timeline sidepanel. Chosen: separate panels to keep matrix dense and timeline filterable.
- Default view: show team matrix. Global roles available via top breadcrumb to avoid cognitive overload for orgs with >100 roles.

Backlog grooming (epics -> stories)
- Epic CON-1287: Roles Matrix v1 (MVP)
   - CON-1287.1: Grid UI, server-side pagination, search, basic assignment editor (3 SP)
   - CON-1287.2: Assignment history (5 SP)
   - CON-1287.3: Role severity badges + tooltips (2 SP)
- Epic CON-1292: Key Lifecycle & Rotation UX
   - CON-1292.1: Create/rotate key modal + copy-once UX (3 SP)
   - CON-1292.2: Staged rotation preview engine (8 SP - needs routing interaction with infra)
   - CON-1292.3: SDK snippets + deployment recipes (2 SP)
   - CON-1292.4: Rotation audit link & suppression action (3 SP)
- Nice-to-have: auto-suggest rotation cadence based on last-used timestamp (future). (5 SP)

Acceptance criteria (MVP)
- Roles Matrix loads under 1s for orgs with 500 principals (server-side).
- Owner can edit assignments and see immediate audit events for those edits.
- Create/rotate key modal returns new secret and writes rotation event to audit log within 5s.
- Staged rotation preview shows affected routes and a conservative traffic % estimate (tolerance +/- 10%).

Copy and microcopy notes
- Key creation confirmation: "This secret will be shown once. Copy it now and store in your secret manager. You will be able to download a rotated key via the audit log record."
- Rotation staged banner: "Staged rotation in progress — new key will start handling traffic at <start time>. You can cancel or shorten the overlap window."
- Role badge tooltip: "Provides read access to logs and metrics. Cannot make changes to models or billing."

Accessibility and keyboard flows
- Matrix must be navigable by keyboard: focus enters grid -> arrow keys move cells -> Enter opens inline editor -> Escape cancels.
- Modal dialogs should trap focus and provide ARIA labels for each field and action.

Open questions / risks (short)
- How do we compute "traffic %" for staged rotation in multi-route, multi-region routing? Need input from routing team (SRE/infra). (CON-1292 DEPENDS ON INFRA-2210)
- Third-party integrations: some customers keep keys embedded in vendors; rotating keys may break integrations. We show a checklist in the confirm dialog but should consider an API that notifies known vendor integrations.
- Audit retention: long-term retention is premium; UI should make it clear when results are partial due to retention policy.

Design/interaction notes (for mockups)
- Use compact table (40px row) for matrix with hover detail. Mobile responsive: collapse matrix to list per principal with accordion for role assignments.
- Color token: green = least privilege, amber = elevated, red = admin; also provide secondary iconography for billing-level permissions.
- On rotate modal, include a small timeline viz (bar) showing overlap window and expected cutover. Not a full chart - simple horizon bar.

Testing / telemetry
- Track events: key.rotate.initiated, key.rotate.completed, role.assignment.changed, audit.view.opened with metadata (principal_id, key_id, team_id)
- Instrument time-to-perform rotation and errors for SLOs.

Implementation notes (hand-off)
- Backend must expose endpoints: GET /org/{org}/roles-matrix, PATCH /assignment/{id}, POST /keys/rotate (with staged params), GET /audit?principal={id}&key={id}
- Frontend should be implemented in new Console Roles module; reuse existing table components. Use feature flag roles-matrix-v1 for staged rollout.

Next steps (owners)
- Asha: consolidate mockups and handoff to design (due 2025-02-21).
- Diego: sync with infra on traffic estimate algorithm + API (blocker) — schedule meeting 2025-02-18.
- Priya: write copy + edge-case microcopy for rotation dialog (due 2025-02-20).
- Evan: create JIRA subtasks and wire up acceptance criteria to automated E2E tests (due 2025-02-26).

Notes to reviewers
- This is intentionally compact; the goal is to ship an MVP that reduces admin friction and makes rotation safe. Be opinionated on defaults: staged rotation = default, overlap window = 24h.
- Feedback particularly requested on: (1) the preview granularity (routes vs. endpoints), (2) acceptance criteria for traffic estimate accuracy, (3) wording for copy-once secret messaging.

Scratch / brainstorm fragments (keep)
- "Notify vendors" toggle? -> maybe too heavy for v1.
- Group-level service account templates (billing-read-only + model-deploy) that can be applied to new teams.  \
- Mini-FAQ: what happens if you lose a key mid-rotation? (revoke old, issue new, emergency window)

References and links
- Confluence draft: Roles Matrix Spec - draft (see linked_artifacts).
- JIRA stories attached above.
- Slack thread: #console-product (thread TSNP-2025-02-11)

-- end of notes --
